deadline.intake: 2027 entry; first-round deadline (rolling after; applications close 2027-08-25)

tuition.note: Annual non-local undergraduate 2026-27; HK$249,000 for Engineering, Science, Medicine, Dentistry and some schools

requirement.text: Apply via Non-JUPAS international qualifications route with school reports, predicted/actual grades (e.g. IB, A-levels), personal statement, referee; IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with Writing and Speaking at least 6.0. Uzbekistan-specific grades not stated.
